head: ChatGPT usage limits run out faster on GPT-6.2 after a billing fix
dek: ChatGPT usage limits now run out about 40% faster with GPT-6.2 Astra and about 25% faster with GPT-6.2 Sol than last week, because OpenAI fixed a launch mistake that had counted these models' usage at a discount. Go, Plus, Pro and Business subscribers get one extra usage reset in return.
details: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux announced the fix on X on 26 November. OpenAI says it won't charge for the difference on past GPT-6.2 usage, and other models keep their usual usage counting. The reset is saved to your account and expires a month after it's added, BleepingComputer reports; tbreak reports it can only be used once a covered allowance is below 80% and that it isn't in the mobile app.
where: ChatGPT Go, Plus, Pro and Business; web and desktop app
means: If you use GPT-6.2 Astra or Sol on a paid plan, the same work now takes a bigger share of your allowance, so you may reach your limit sooner.
todo: Open Settings, then Usage (Usage & billing in the desktop app) on ChatGPT's website or desktop app to see your allowance and use the extra reset when you need it.
